positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Refactoring of app MVI architecture to enable more focused domain-to-presentation mapping, reducing state complexity and eliminating layer coupling that had created bottlenecks for rapid experimentation and feature iteration.
- Eliminated ANR bottlenecks in high-scale live rooms (500+ participants) by optimizing ViewModel-to-View binding patterns and auditing RecyclerView implementations to prevent unnecessary diff operations
- Built Android monetization infrastructure for Clubhouse Plus with clean Composable abstraction that encapsulated paywall complexity, enabling feature developers to integrate subscription gates with minimal code through a simple wrapper API.
- Architected server-driven onboarding system in partnership with backend counterpart to replace hardcoded navigation flows, enabling dynamic sequencing and A/B testing of user segments; validated through controlled experiment before expanding to new flows.
- Presented tech talk on AI-assisted development covering prompting best practices, reusable context documentation, and problem-solving approaches to accelerate development workflows tailored to the codebase.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Android
positions.description:
- Initiated and led project to migrate webview-based content screens to native Jetpack Compose (also implemented native video playback with exoplayer), reducing load times from 4s+ to less than 500ms, boosting app performance for a heavily trafficked part of the application.
- Led migration of feature flagging on Android to LaunchDarkly from a legacy internal solution, including rolling out training and guidance to the Android engineering team utilizing an abstraction-based approach for implementation, which reduced  coupling with any one flagging solution. Additional targeting functionality allowed minimal risk of new feature launches.
- Took ownership of hard technical problems within the app, including: tidying up lifecycle handling to resolve several ‘mystery’ crashes causing a decrease in crash rate by 50% and performing an app-wide audit of memory leaks, resulting in resolving several instances of large views being leaked.
- Used spare cycles to enhance telemetry, including pruning excessively noisy events to allow on-call engineers to have a more actionable set of alerts/Sentry issues for analysis, which provided greater prominence to actual app issues.
- Transitioned ‘Learn’ pillar of the app from legacy view-based screens with tightly coupled architecture to Compose-based server driven UI utilizing an MVI architecture.
- Tidied up OkHttp clients and Picasso instances including adding caching to improve load performance of user-impactful screens such as the homepage.
- Provided technical mentorship for mid-level engineers on the team, including code reviews and conducting candidate interviews.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Android
positions.description:
- Technical ownership of monetization and member engagement pillars of the on-device experience working to sequence and plan strategy in collaboration with 3 engineers.
- Partnered with QA team to execute improvements to on-device subscription paywall.
- Updated the onboarding flow to ensure collection of a valid location for calculation of sales tax, providing additional revenue collection – coordinated with program and QA teams to align on  updates to the ‘Day 0’ out-of-box OTA for new hardware installation.
- Updated the Wifi and Bluetooth connection settings UX on the Tonal to allow greater discoverability and ease of connection of devices during workouts.

positions.title: Product Partnerships - Google Maps for Automotive
positions.description:
- Launched critical features to support vehicle program launches incorporating deeper in-vehicle integration to support L2+ AD-optimized routing and enhancing support for HMI integration including new display shapes and deeper cluster integration.
- Led product planning cycles with several OEMs to build out a feature roadmap.
- Process improvements to enhance forward visibility of OEM needs.

positions.title: Partner Engineering, Android Automotive
positions.description:
- Worked with partners to incorporate new features to the Android framework, including enhancements to the Android Bluetooth stack to support automotive use cases.
- Supported MY19 vehicles through certification of their Android Auto implementations.
- Presented Android compatibility best-practices to 300 attendees at the Android Automotive Bootcamp with goal of encouraging continuous validation of compatibility and setting a higher threshold for forking the core Android framework citing cost to the developer ecosystem given increased complexity.

positions.title: Partner Engineering - Android Wear
positions.description:
- Device lead for Casio and TAG Heuer smartwatch launches.
- Root causing issues identified by devices in the internal dogfood pool through analysis of bugreport traces and field metrics.
- Investigated issues such as battery drain using heuristics such as long wakelocks, radio states and CPU usage.
- Negotiated launch schedules with partners balancing software readiness with factory constraints.
- Handling incoming partner code submissions to code review and validating using custom Android builds as necessary.

positions.title: Partner Technology Manager - Google Shopping Express
positions.description:
- Acted to project manage the implementations of major retailers to join the Google Express platform.
- Provided implementation advise and best practices to retailers as they progressed.
- Prototyped initial scaling tools for onboarding new retailers to the platform before working to productionize the tools with the internal engineering team.
- Acted in a pre-sales capacity to assist in the deal process.
- Provided support for Google's product metadata and imaging initiatives including tools to optimize the operations.

positions.title: Partner Technology Manager - Play Magazines
positions.description:
- Worked to provide content ingestion tracking throughout the processing pipeline for the wider cross functional group.
- Developed specifications for a workflow management tool for managing the manual magazine production process.
- Developed an initial prototype of a CRM tool for managing engagements with major publishers.

positions.title: Technical Account Manager - Google Shopping & Google Books
positions.description:
As the primary local contact in the Australian office for partner engineering I worked in a split role between the Google Shopping and Google Books products based on product requirements.

Launch of Google Shopping in Australia:
- Worked with the wider cross-functional team (Partnerships, Product and Operations) to prepare the product for launch.
- Provided support for the Partnerships BD team by acting in a Strategic Partner Management capacity, directly engaging and maintaining relationships with key partners prior to launch.
- Created initial post-launch reporting and metrics to measure launch success.
- Worked with key strategic marketplace partners, providing high-touch consultative service to assist with their development efforts.
- Speaker at the Online Retailer Australia conference in Sydney, working to get merchants engaged with Google Shopping soon after launch.
- Guest speaker at the ChannelAdvisor summit in Melbourne.
- Met with local startups in the Shopping/Commerce space to understand potential synergies with Google's Shopping offerings.

Google Books Australia Launch:
- Provided development support for external retail integration efforts including, when needed side-by-side walkthroughs of code to debug technical issues.
- Provided guidance in using the Google Books third party API including the creation of code snippets and best practices during implementation.
- Assisted with debugging content ingestion issues with the pipeline with publisher partners.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Tech lead for team of 10 developers for J2EE portal engagement for an Australian public sector client.
- Contributed to development framework including new coding-pattern recommendations rolled out to the wider project team.
- Development using a tech stack including GIT, Java and Spring.
